title: ever OPAHL|Silver Metallic Fabric V-Neck A-Line Wedding Guest Dress Featuring Delicate Ruffled Hem
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your wedding guest attire with this chic and sophisticated V-neck A-line dress. The short sleeves offer comfort and style, while the ruffle hem adds a touch of feminine charm. Crafted from silver crinkle fabric, this dress shimmers elegantly under the lights, making it perfect for any special occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Tea Length.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric: The garment comprises polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
